liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dondante** (1 review): Listener calls this the best version of Dondante they have ever heard [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **August 2022 (Friday)**: rare: 4 archived performances [8]
- **Cobra**: back after 38 archived shows (1637 days) [8]
- **If All Else Fails**: rare: 5 archived performances [8]

## The recordings

- **mmj2022-08-26.leary** (recommended): source not stated; 24 songs; 172 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Listener notes the recording features an extremely high level of slappage throughout the performance; Listener describes the recording as having particularly high levels of birth-canal slappage [5][6]
- **mmj2022-08-26.schoeps_mk4v_flac24**: source not stated; 23 songs; 175 min [2]
- **mmj2022-08-26.schoeps_mk22_cmc1k_flac24**: source not stated; 23 songs; 175 min [3]
- **mmj2022-08-26.mk4**: source not stated; 24 songs; 175 min [4]. Said about its sound: Slight wind noise present, minimized by using dead rats lent by Alex Leary [4]

## Around the show

- Experiencing Dondante live at Red Rocks was described as an otherworldly moment [7]
- Joy Oladokun opened the first of two nights at the venue [1]
- Joy Oladokun opened the first of two nights at the venue [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2022-08-26.leary**: taped by Alex Leary; transferred by Alex Leary; source: DPA 4023 > Sound Devices MixPre-6 (24/48) [1]
- **mmj2022-08-26.schoeps_mk4v_flac24**: taped by Andy Murray; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Schoeps mk4v>cmc1k>Sonosax SX-R4+ 24bit/96khz DIN [2]. Also: Recorded and transferred by Andy Murray, clamped to the center back side of the SBD rail [2]
- **mmj2022-08-26.schoeps_mk22_cmc1k_flac24**: taped by Andy Murray; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Schoeps mk22>cmc1k>Sonosax SX-R4+ 24bit/96khz NOS [3]. Also: Recorded and transferred by Andy Murray, clamped to the center back side of the SBD rail [3]
- **mmj2022-08-26.mk4**: taped by Humbug; transferred by Humbug; source: Schoeps MK4's > Nbob Actives > NBox Platinum > Sony PCM-M10 @ 24/48 [4]. Also: Recorded by Humbug using Schoeps MK4s into a Sony PCM-M10, clamped behind the board [4]
